value.rationale: Balanced complete multipartite graphs form a natural two-parameter family. The result gives an entire maximum-volume Euclidean ellipsoid (center, complete three-eigenspace spectrum, volume) and establishes contact with all ar+a^r facets using a positive certificate. This answers a structurally motivated invariant not determined by bipartite, traversal, or LP-persistency results. The claims are confined to the proved family.
